subject: Pilot kickoff & success criteria — Greenline Health
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 15:05:00 +0000
Subject: Pilot kickoff & success criteria — Greenline Health

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed minimal pilot so we can show measurable value quickly. Please confirm and flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you shared:
- High false positive rate on triage classification (ER vs. follow-up) increasing clinician overhead
- Long turnaround for notes normalization and coding (~24–48 hrs)
- Concerns about PHI handling and auditability for ML outputs

Goals for a 6-week pilot:
- Reduce triage false positives by 20% on sampled workflows (measured via labeled eval set)
- Deliver normalized note drafts for 50–100 encounters/day with a human-in-loop accuracy target of >= 90%
- Provide audit logs and token-level retention settings for compliance review

Pilot scope (minimum viable):
- Model: open LLM variant we discussed (redwood/llm-v2-qa), hosted in Dedicated for predictable latency
- Prompts: 1) triage classification, 2) note normalization template (we will provide prompt matrices)
- Eval set: Greenline to provide ~600 labeled triage examples + 200 notes for normalization quality checks
- Success metrics: classification precision/recall, note normalization ROUGE-lite + human review pass rate

Owners / roles:
- Greenline: Alyssa (clinical owner), Dan Park (SRE) — please confirm emails
- Redwood: Vanessa (AM, pilot lead), Marissa (SE, prompt/eval), Sean (CS, rollout/support)

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): access & security kickoff, sign brief MOU
- Week 1: infra & data connectivity, initial prompt draft upload
- Weeks 2–4: iterative evals and prompt tuning + weekly checkpoints
- Week 5: holdout eval + ops runbook handoff
- Week 6: results review and next-step proposal

Access & pre-reqs we need from Greenline:
- SFTP or secure S3 access for eval data (credentials to our tenant or temporary exchange)
- Completed security questionnaire (we can accept your standard or ours)
- List of accounts for RBAC (email list for owners)

Attachments: redwood-pilot-checklist.pdf (pilot checklist & quick access guide)

Next steps (can we):
1) Confirm owners and a security contact by EOD tomorrow
2) Share a short MOU (I will send a DocuSign link)
3) Schedule a 30–45 minute security/access kickoff with your SRE next week

If that all looks correct I can send the DocuSign & internal kickoff invite.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0168
